exposure: sequential use of intracervical foley catheter followed by misoprostol
cohort: 130 patients undergoing labor induction at Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, divided into two groups (one receiving vaginal misoprostol and the other receiving a Foley catheter followed by misoprostol).
finding: Both vaginal misoprostol and the sequential approach (Foley catheter followed by misoprostol) were similarly effective in inducing labor, with comparable induction-to-delivery intervals, modes of delivery, and neonatal outcomes.
gest_age: term pregnancy (implied, but not explicitly stated)
birth_weight: <3500 gms (mentioned as favorable factor, but not as inclusion criteria)
